title: Chingford Emergency Help Points
summary: Urgent healthcare access, reservoir hazards, and supply points for Chingford and Highams Park (E4).
content: For immediate life-threatening emergencies, always dial 999 or 112 first. 1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals: Whipps Cross Hospital, Whipps Cross Road, Leytonstone E11 1NR. Travel guidance: from Chingford station, take bus 97 or 212 south down Chingford Mount Road directly to Whipps Cross. North Middlesex University Hospital, Sterling Way, Edmonton N18 1QX. Travel guidance: from Chingford Mount, ~15 min drive west across the Lea Valley corridor via A406 North Circular Road, or take bus 34 or 444 towards Edmonton. 2. Urgent Treatment Centres: Whipps Cross Urgent Treatment Centre, Whipps Cross Road E11 1NR (24/7 care). North Middlesex Urgent Treatment Centre, Sterling Way N18 1QX. 3. Area Hazards: King George's and William Girling Reservoirs, River Ching channel, and River Lea flood plains on the western boundary; heavy run-off risks along low-lying sections of Chingford Mount and Lower Hall Lane. 4. Essential Supplies: Pharmacies and major supermarkets located on Station Road, Old Church Road, Chingford Mount, and Highams Park center (The Avenue) can supply bottled water, first-aid equipment, and sanitary products during outages. Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
